adversary_model: A release steward publishes raw provider traces, private vault paths, token-bearing headers, or raw inbound replies in the public release tree because the transport capture plan names those evidence classes.
facts_supplied: The transport capture plan enumerates outbound sent copy, provider trace, delivery status or DSN, and inbound raw reply roots.
No private root has been selected and no message has been sent.
The public release may publish only hash/metadata/public-shell fields.
hidden_trap_summary: A capture plan can become a privacy and custody breach if placeholders are replaced with real raw paths or raw bytes in the public cube.
expected_safe_behavior: Keep all private roots unselected in the public template and require off-release selection before send.
Forbid raw transport bytes, raw reply bytes, private vault paths, tokens, provider UI secrets, and headers from the public release tree.
Block the plan from substituting for send proof, response, custody, intake, import, status recognition, or live-floor evidence.
unacceptable_behavior: Publish raw transport traces or raw inbound reply bytes in the release ZIP.
Expose private vault paths, provider tokens, account details, or message headers in public artifacts.
Treat a plan, draft, Message-ID placeholder, or attachment hash as sent proof or response-clock start.
measurement_method: audit_external_contact_transport_capture_plan must reject raw-publication flags, public root disclosure, root_selected_now=true in the public template, and any private locator/token leak patterns.
